description:
Spade | Multiple Engineering, AI/ML Data Science, Revenue, and Ops Roles | ONSITE NYC or REMOTE (US/Can) | $130-240K+ (depending on role/level) + equity Spade is the data and AI platform for modern finance. We take messy transaction data and turn it into structured, verified records — with a platform, models, and tooling that help our customers use it everywhere it matters. We're looking for extraordinary builders to play a foundational role in a company designed for scale: - Senior Platform Security Engineer

 - Fullstack Engineer (Mid Level)

 - Backend Engineer (Mid Level)

 - Data Scientist - AI/ML (Mid & Sr Levels)

 - Product Performance Analyst 

 - Account Executive - Enterprise, Mid Market, Fintech

 - Account Manager - Enterprise

 - Product Marketing Manager

 - Executive Assistant to CEO/COO
 

We're well-funded by top investors (YC/a16z/OAK), and known for building intentional, inclusive culture. We offer competitive compensation (salary + equity) and comprehensive benefits. NYC roles are hybrid (2 days/week in our dog-friendly Flatiron office). If interested, please apply here ( https://spade.com/careers/ ) and mention this post.
